# PFP Logistics

PFP Logistics is a Warehousing and Storage company. PFP Logistics is a third-party provider (3pl) that specializes in warehouse staffing on a piece rate. They service the cold storage, grocery, retail, and tire industries nationwide. They also provide onsite management to ensure high quality labor. PFP Logistics employs 54 people (+38.5% YoY, +15 people), founded in 2006. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, United States.

PFP Logistics is an agile 3PL specializing in staffing warehouses and distribution centers nationwide.

# PFP Logistics

PFP Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. PFP Logistics employs 29 people. Its workforce is distributed across Sri Lanka, United States, and Mexico.

## About

Because every dispatch is a fresh challenge and because every type of goods is different from every other, we have a logistical platform of highly skilled employees. 
 
Every task is analysed in order to offer the most economical, but also the safest, solution (security, speed, vigilance,...).
We manage your dispatches as though they were our own.
 
We arrange all required Customs formalities and store your goods in our 10,000-m2 depot facility.
 
At your request the packaging of your goods can be revised to match your cost constraints. We will repackage all your products to ensure that they arrive at their destination in the preferred packaging.
 
PFP Asia Logistics is much more than a logistics company; it is the right solution for you, regardless of destination.

## Company Details
- Industry: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
- Type: Public company
- Homepage: pfp-asia.com
- Aliases: pfp logistics
- LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/pfp-logistics
- Linkedin Followers: 75

## Workforce
- Employees: 29
- Company Size: 11-50 employees
- Breakdown:
  - By Country: Sri Lanka: 2 (7%), United States: 2 (7%), Mexico: 1 (3%)
  - By Department: Sales: 2 (7%), Hr: 1 (3%), Research: 1 (3%), Trades: 1 (3%)
